profiles.label: profile-gated
profiles.scope: complete physical-line six-stage sequences on calling thread in child workers only; parent seed excluded; frontend background threads excluded from calling-thread CPU. Sum worker wall durations is not whole makespan. Response serialization/witness construction follows final checkpoint. Partial/damaged/panic intervals censored, never reconstructed. Profile-only binaries.
